findings.title: Go 1.19 is end-of-life
findings.description: Go 1.19 (release line 1.19) reached end-of-life on 2023-08-08. It no longer receives security fixes, so known vulnerabilities in it stay unpatched. Each Go release is supported until two newer major releases exist.

impact.technical: Unpatched vulnerabilities and increasing incompatibility with current libraries and platforms.
impact.business: Security and compliance exposure that grows over time, and upgrades that get larger the longer they are postponed.

remediation.summary: Upgrade Go to a supported release line (see https://endoflife.date/go) and test the application against it.

findings.false_positive_guidance: If the declared version is only a minimum (e.g. >=12) and production runs a newer release, update the declaration to match.
